newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 3.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Dec. 3:

WASHINGTON - A Congressional advisory panel will call for alterations in the way the government calculates changes in consumer prices that would slow the growth of many federal benefit programs by 1.1 percentage points a year.

WASHINGTON - The Federal Trade Commission subpoenaed videotape and other documents from Stroh Brewery Co. as part of an investigation to determine whether its TV ad campaign is attempting to lure underage viewers.
NEW YORK - CITA Americas Inc., a New York based company, is marketing a rapid drug detoxification process its says makes treatment profitable, but experts have doubts.
